scenarios.prompt: Which local resource kinds support search, and which supported kind can only be listed and read?
Find Pikachu locally and report its height, weight, and types with evidence.
What abilities does Bulbasaur have, and which is hidden? Use only local Pokédex evidence.
Which weighs more, Bulbasaur or Charmander, and by how much in PokéAPI weight units?
List the names on the second page of Pokémon when page size is 3. Start at the beginning and use the returned cursor.
Starting at the beginning with page size 3, continue until you have observed six Pokémon names. An empty page may still have a continuation cursor.
Starting from a search for Bulbasaur, follow local relationships through its species to its evolution chain. Name the later species in that chain.
Find Generation I, follow its main region relationship, and name that region and one Pokédex related to it.
Find Pikachu and report its base experience. Recover from retryable tool errors using their retry advice.
Find Charmander, follow its species relationship, and report the species color. Recover from retryable tool failures.

From the first page of four Pokémon, which weigh more than 100 PokéAPI weight units? Report their names. Establish the candidate set before reading details, check every candidate, and avoid unrelated lookups. Return only a names claim for the matching records, with all examined records cited on that claim. Put the examination scope in the summary, not in another names claim.

Inspect the first page of four Pokémon. With only three tool calls total, read as many of those records as the remaining allowance permits, in page order. Among the records you actually read, which weigh more than 100 PokéAPI weight units? Report their names and state the limited scope in your summary; do not claim anything about unread candidates. Return only a names claim for the matching records, with all examined records cited on that claim. Put the examination scope in the summary, not in another names claim.

From the first page of four Pokémon, compare only the entries named Bulbasaur and Charmander. Which is heavier, and by how much in PokéAPI weight units? Use the returned candidate records to choose useful followups; spare calls are not a reason to read unrelated records.

From the first page of four Pokémon, report the names ending in "saur". Use only the information needed to answer this name question; spare calls are not a reason to read details. Return only a names claim for the matching records, with all examined records cited on that claim. Put the examination scope in the summary, not in another names claim.
